subject: Human Body
title: Phagocytes: The Cell Eaters
description: Learn Phagocytes: The Cell Eaters in one minute.

hook.text: Some white blood cells eat bacteria alive. They engulf, digest, and destroy invaders in minutes.

buildup.text: Neutrophils arrive first at infection sites. They live only hours but devour bacteria at astonishing speed.

twist.text: Pus is a mixture of dead neutrophils and bacteria. That yellowish fluid at a wound site is evidence of a won battle.

climax.text: Phagocytes are the infantry. They charge in, consume the enemy, and often die in the process.

punchline.text: White blood cells eat bacteria alive. Pus is the aftermath.
